description: This file defines a React context provider component for managing responsive pane state within a web application. It provides context values such as the currently selected pane, toggle functions for panes, and layout controls, integrating with a pane controller and handling Android back button events.

methods.name: useResponsiveAppPane
methods.description: Custom hook to access the ResponsivePaneContext; throws error if used outside of provider.

methods.name: ResponsivePaneProvider
methods.description: React component that provides pane state and controls via context, managing pane layout, selection, and Android back button handling.
